title: Understanding Data Augmentation under Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2610.27701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data augmentation (DA) has become a fundamental component of modern machine learning systems and is widely regarded as an effective strategy for improving robustness and generalization. Despite its empirical success, the theoretical impact of DA under label noise remains poorly understood. In this work, we first theoretically explain when DA is beneficial and when it becomes detrimental, and provide sufficient conditions for distinguishing between these two regimes under both the i.i.d. learning setting and the more challenging domain generalization scenario. Then, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: DA essentially acts as an uncertainty amplifier in the learning process, decreasing model stability and generalization performance. This finding is supported by the proposed learning and generalization bounds. translated_title: 理解标签噪声下的数据增强
translated_abstract: 数据增强已成为现代机器学习系统的基本组成部分，并被广泛认为是提高鲁棒性和泛化能力的有效策略。尽管其在实践中取得了成功，但数据增强在标签噪声下的理论影响仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们首先从理论上解释了数据增强何时有益、何时有害，并在独立同分布学习设置和更具挑战性的领域泛化场景下，提供了区分这两种情况的充分条件。然后，我们揭示了一个反直觉的现象：数据增强在学习过程中实质上充当了不确定性放大器，降低了模型的稳定性和泛化性能。这一发现得到了所提出的学习界和泛化界的支持。我们的分析不依赖于特定的数据增强技术，且仅需温和的假设，表明这些结果具有广泛的适用性。
tldr: 本文从理论上刻画了标签噪声下数据增强有益或有害的条件，并揭示了数据增强实质上是不确定性放大器、会降低模型稳定性与泛化性能这一反直觉现象。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically characterizes when data augmentation is beneficial or detrimental under label noise, revealing the counterintuitive phenomenon that DA essentially acts as an uncertainty amplifier, decreasing model stability and generalization performance.
